frozen_e.runtime_guard: completed Mac FullRunWorker AutoplayLoopGuard; no Windows facade
frozen_e.selected_by: authorized Blue90k win_q25_r30 scheduled training checkpoint; no selection in this run

applies_to: isolated battle contexts of every act1ft stage
scope.effect: a chosen legal option matching reviewed class A/B is refused BEFORE native execution (no engine call, no RNG, no step counter); the session closes unsupported with reason limit:battle_unbounded_autoplay_loop; every other request is delegated to the original Session.Step unchanged
scope.episode_rule: a refused episode is unsupported: the whole episode is never stored (zero replay prefix) and is counted separately as guard_refusals
scope.full_run_battles: played inside the owned FullRunWorker with its own byte-identical AutoplayLoopGuard copy

frozen_e.used: online state_dict only; source target/Adam/replay ignored

initial_weights_rule: torch.manual_seed(config.seed) at setup, then StrategyQNet construction; sha256 over the sorted state_dict names/dtypes/shapes/bytes (artifacts.state_dict_sha256)

learning_contract.empty_tier_fallback: an empty tier's quota moves one tier lower, recursively
learning_contract.objective: explicitly success-weighted Huber over the sampled mixture; no importance correction; no TD-error priority
learning_contract.retention: tier 0 recent-row ring; tiers 1-4 whole-trajectory FIFO references within their row capacities, oldest first
learning_contract.return: sum of rewards over up to 1 real strategy decisions; bootstrap only at the next real decision; stop at a natural terminal; undefined runs contribute no rows
learning_contract.sampling: tier 0 uniform rows; each quality tier a uniform retained trajectory, then a uniform row; with replacement; never consumed
learning_contract.tiers: nested, from the resolved natural training outcome: 0 every valid trace; 1 actual act >= 2; 2 actual act 3; 3 an actual Act 3 room=boss combat entry; 4 native run victory
learning_contract.update_credit: each unique valid online row once; memberships and draws add no credit

metadata.source: frozen catalog definitions + rs1 categorical vocabularies; no recorded choices

potion_actions.observation_fields: round_number, allow_potions, potion_capacity, potion_slot_array (potion mode only)

original_worker_hello_nested.seed_derivation: sts2-training-seed-splitmix-xxh64/v1: seed(name) = splitmix64 pair of (env_seed ^ xxh64(version) ^ xxh64(name)*golden)
original_worker_hello_nested.terminal_boundary: CombatEngine.Step terminal, before RunEngine.FinishCombatStep and reward-time hooks: Burning Blood / Chosen Cheese heals, Improvement upgrades, Pumpkin Candle, Toy Box, Royalties and similar run mutations are NOT applied

reward.act: CurrentActIndex + 1 (region ids Overgrowth/Underdocks/Hive/Glory are not acts)
reward.excluded: E's combat reward and potion bill are never added
reward.once: each fight id (run_id:fNNN) is paid at most once
